# Joy AC Hall & Rooms

> Budget-friendly AC dormitory hall and family rooms accommodation in Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu, India. Located on the National Highway in Thangachimadam, perfect for pilgrimage groups, school tours, family travelers, and tourists visiting Ramanathaswamy Temple, Pamban Bridge, Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Memorial, and Dhanushkodi Beach.

## Property summary

- **Name:** Joy AC Hall & Rooms (also known as Joy AC Hall & Dormitory)
- **Type:** Lodging / Dormitory / Group accommodation
- **Address:** 4/3001, Valasai St, Akkalmadam, Thangachimadam, Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu 623529, India
- **Phone:** +91 81224 45538
- **Email:** admin@joyachall.com
- **Website:** https://joyachall.com/
- **Price range:** ₹250 per person (dormitory) to ₹3,600 per room (family deluxe)
- **Currencies:** INR
- **Languages:** English, Tamil, Hindi
- **Check-in / out:** Open 24/7
- **Aggregate rating:** 5.0 / 5 (Google Reviews)

## Accommodation options

1. **Dormitory Hall** — 30 to 50 person AC dormitory hall with 4 shared bathrooms. Best for pilgrimage groups, school tours and large travel groups. Both AC and Non-AC variants available. From ₹250 per person. URL: https://joyachall.com/rooms/dormitory-hall
2. **Family Deluxe Room** — 8 person family room with attached bathroom. Both AC and Non-AC variants. From ₹3,600 per room. URL: https://joyachall.com/rooms/family-deluxe-room
3. **Double Room** — 4 person room with electric kettle and wardrobe. Both AC and Non-AC variants. From ₹2,000 per room. URL: https://joyachall.com/rooms/double-room

## Amenities

WiFi, AC rooms, RO drinking water, CCTV security, free parking, dining area, kitchen space, cooking vessels, speakers and mic, hot water, electric kettle, TV in rooms, bus parking, 24/7 security.

- Dhanushkodi & Arichal Munai — 19 km (20 min drive)
